The combination created allot of problems. My review is for the Sampaloc Manila location.

Dentagem Dentist Clinic have two locations Marikina and Sampaloc Manila. They offer free consultation and take PayPal payments for Westerners. Contacting the office was made easy thru Whatsapp and everyone spoke English.

The clinic itself is basic.  Your won’t find high-tech minimalist lounges, but rather a space stripped of unnecessary distractions. It is an unpretentious, straightforward practice that prioritizes what truly matters: a sterile, fully equipped environment and reliable, essential affordable dental care.

Hands down the best dental experience I’ve ever had!  From the moment I walked in, the front desk staff  consist of Jessa and Dimples was incredibly welcoming, super patient.  I had lots and lots of questions. Questions about procedures, pricing appointments, soooo many questions. I really appreciate it the transparent pricing. There was no surprises here No extra charges. Did I mention how Super patient they were and always service with a smile.  😁

I saw Dr. Eric first with assistant Carina, for my FREE consultation.  He was wonderful so very professional, honest and thorough during my cleaning, explaining every step so there were no surprises and didn't try to push any unnecessary treatments on me. They gave me great, practical advice for my daily routine.

On my next visit, one of many I had the pleasure of having Dr. Rayan. He took the time to sit down, thoroughly explain the work that's was needed and walk me through exactly what to expect during the procedure. He was incredibly gentle, constantly checked in to make sure I wasn't in any pain, and worked with amazing precision. Dr. Rayan worked on my teeth 1 day 6 hours straight in a chair, no joke. I needed that much work.
How did I pull 6 hours? Well Dr. Rayan and his beautiful dental assistant Michelle serenaded  me with radio on in background to classics like Cindy Lauper Girls Just Want To Have Fun and John Denver, Take Me Home Country Road.
Over the next few visits my teeth got the VIP treatment.  Dr. Rayan, had the precision of a ninja, the  touch of a feather, the artistry of a master.

If you are looking for a highly skilled, compassionate dentist who genuinely cares about patient comfort, with transparent affordable pricing  this is the place to go.","Images":["https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmPknNGb1YqxZnRVA9aGxcvkBHa4toKIOh8hN7X-C2rV2D6_o1RqC1Ng4ij_bnloRjTn2VT-VD0dkPIwvXL4mZABdO99NMmaF7N7j6zuxV7aO2Q_fT-YUOgh42-0MM3ZHlhbP_J2=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmPGYhuFa4kL_H41JClgeY_0JAFAVo2xy_sIxfzNTlFWNIJ3Ei4GznGzGnK_uC4vcZSgeUMjMhPIoz3aJzoT3QaLsnPh2tE7s1Ubdu5ordsNKIoDfgkJ4O30mvSvCT3ijHMCKjv1BYL5vzjc=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmPqnK5yr7YZU2ct4Q6UORxAenGOh2AHTEED2VTMHSR91X4TivcG132PA7p88A2NCzCETCP62wkNYLRe28oTplc3so9V-1NCEXkGEV9OKxPp1U4Eqxc-z2jU_uBT-bMddGbhrwGFR5B0Rkol=k-no","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/grass-cs/ACvplmP094jICh3rZwCtObefkDiFm11GwB89oeUoVPIewDnqoWTg6j0XvQsJ3xeKgCZThXQRoVtopUBF2AQDFenLwO5mJnKE7R1o6Dm4ntlGDejdHcEINJ7J53tOYg8zK1Qraa9gdpf-=k-no"],"When":"4 months ago","review_id":"Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tJeWJXMTNWV0pGTmpWRFVGb3RlRzVhUWtSU1VVRRAB","source":"Google","rating_scale":5,"rating_float":5,"author_url":"https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114894892844462382961/reviews?hl=en-US","posted_at_unix_micros":1779753509064970,"updated_at_unix_micros":1779753603020640,"language":"en","translated_lang":"","text_original":"I had neglected my teeth for the past 2 years stop going for my semi annual cleaning and picked up some bad habits of eating late at night... audit.summary: The DentaGem Dental Clinics website relies on an older website builder framework with keyword-stuffed metadata. Modernizing the platform, refining on-page SEO, and optimizing user journeys will improve local search visibility and patient conversion rates.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on the DentaGem Sampaloc site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking up dental clinics in Manila and came across the DentaGem site in Sampaloc. It's great to see your practice serving the community.

While browsing, I noticed the site is running on an older GoDaddy builder framework, and the page titles are currently packed with a long list of keywords. Unfortunately, search engines often flag that kind of overstuffing as spam, which can hurt your local visibility and make it harder for new patients to find you.

We put together a quick, modernized demo of the site with cleaner code and streamlined SEO. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,

Your Name
